messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Tell your doctor and pharmacist about all the medicines you take, including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal products.
Medicines that need particular care:
- Lithium. Lithium and diuretics generally should not be taken together. Hydrochlorothiazide reduces how quickly the kidneys clear lithium, which carries a high risk of lithium toxicity.
- Cholestyramine and colestipol. These cholesterol-lowering resins bind hydrochlorothiazide in the gut and can reduce how much you absorb by up to 85 percent for cholestyramine and 43 percent for colestipol. The doses need to be separated. For the oral suspension, the label advises taking hydrochlorothiazide at least 4 hours before, or 4 to 6 hours after, the resin.
- NSAIDs such as ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin), naproxen (Aleve), diclofenac, meloxicam, indomethacin, celecoxib and aspirin. These can reduce the fluid-clearing and blood-pressure-lowering effects of hydrochlorothiazide, and your doctor will check whether the medicine is still working as intended.
Triples: [["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "interacts with", "lithium"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "interacts with", "cholestyramine"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "interacts with", "colestipol"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has interaction with", "NSAIDs"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has interaction with", "ibuprofen"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has interaction with", "naproxen"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has interaction with", "diclofenac"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has interaction with", "meloxicam"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has interaction with", "indomethacin"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has interaction with", "celecoxib"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has interaction with", "aspirin"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has reduced absorption due to", "cholestyramine"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has reduced absorption due to", "colestipol"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has absorption reduction percentage", "85 percent with cholestyramine"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has absorption reduction percentage", "43 percent with colestipol"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has administration instruction", "take at least 4 hours before or 4 to 6 hours after cholestyramine or colestipol"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has diminished effect", "fluid clearance"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has diminished effect", "blood pressure lowering"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has monitoring requirement", "effectiveness of medication"]]
Relations: ["has absorption reduction percentage", "has administration instruction", "has diminished effect", "has interaction with", "has monitoring requirement", "has reduced absorption due to", "interacts with"]
Answer:

completion:
has absorption reduction percentage: The subject drug's absorption is reduced by the specified percentage when taken with the object drug or substance.  
has administration instruction: The subject drug should be administered at the specified time relative to the object drug or substance to avoid reduced efficacy or adverse effects.  
has diminished effect: The subject drug's intended physiological effect, such as fluid clearance or blood pressure lowering, is reduced when used in combination with the object entity.  
has interaction with: The subject drug exhibits a pharmacological or physiological interaction when co-administered with the object drug or substance, potentially altering its efficacy or safety.  
has monitoring requirement: The subject drug requires regular monitoring of its effectiveness when used in combination with the object entity to ensure proper therapeutic outcomes.  
has reduced absorption due to: The absorption of the subject drug is decreased when co-administered with the object drug or substance.  
interacts with: The subject drug and the object drug or substance produce a pharmacological interaction that may affect the efficacy, safety, or metabolism of one or both.
